label: H.R. 9420
title: Reproductive Health Care Training Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill establishes a grant program that supports training for providers of abortion care.

items.item: Specifically, the Health Resources and Services Administration
items.snippet: Specifically, the Health Resources and Services Administration must award grants to health professional schools, academic health centers, or other nonprofit health care…

Specifically, the Health Resources and Services Administration must award grants to health professional schools, academic health centers, or other nonprofit health care safety net providers to support training in…
Funds may be used to train students, residents, and advanced practice clinicians in abortion care and to connect them to appropriate entities to provide such care, among other activities.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

B001287.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
B001287.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
B001287.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
